title: POST /accounts/api-keys/create
$comment: A new key for the signed-in user (D2.6). permissions are checked against the catalogue by the route (100058), ipAllowlist entries by the route (100062: single IPv4 or IPv6 addresses, at most 20 once duplicates are dropped; empty or absent means any IP). expiresAt must be in the future. The rate limit is not the user's to choose.
